note: Halloween 2026 event (spec for twigo-bot data/events/halloween.json). Times are Philippine time (UTC+8). Numbers marked in halloween-event-plan.md as Claude defaults are waiting on Mac's OK.
name: Halloween in Mikazuki
decorationsStartsAtNote: Repo addition (Mac, 17 Oct 2026): the town's decorations (world/halloween-deco.ts) are up from this instant, before the event itself (startsAt), until endsAt; null = with the event.
startsAtNote: ISO time with +08:00, e.g. "2026-10-25T18:00:00+08:00". null = the event is off (dev: ?halloween=on turns it on locally).
repoNote: Repo copy (17 Oct 2026, Mac): no spawn announcements, so biikko.announceSpawn and manananggal.announceAppear are left out; mirror this in the art folder's copy.
potionsNote: The bot's existing potions (packages/bot/src/potions/potions.ts POTIONS: Swerte Elixir, Tago Tonic, Kalawang Potion), given with addPotions. One is picked at random, equal chances.

mikko.name: Mikko Kalabasa
mikko.hideRules: a walkable tile right next to a tree, bush, fern, rock or junk prop; never on the plaza, a path, a door tile, inside the Slums' safe zone or within 6 tiles of a player when it hides

biikko.name: Biikko Kalabasa
biikko.title: Legendary
biikko.wander: anywhere walkable on height 1 outside the safe zone and the golem pit; picks a spot 4-10 tiles away, walks there, pauses 3-8 s
biikko.firstSpawn: 10 minutes after the event starts (or after a restart while it's down: keep the saved schedule)

loot.owners: the last hitter and their party members in the Slums

biikko.announceKill: {name} landed the last hit on Biikko Kalabasa!

manananggal.name: Manananggal
manananggal.lowerSpotsNote: town tiles beside groves, away from the plaza (checked walkable in maps/town.json); Claude Code re-checks each and drops any that are blocked or behind a building. Repo copy (17 Oct 2026): the art folder's six ([51,60], [26,63], [24,5], [17,13], [66,13], [9,58]) all stood behind tree crowns (73-100% hidden), so each moved to the nearest open grass tile nothing draws over (a bot test keeps them so).

upper.attack: Claw Swipe: one target in front, every 1.8 s, the mob table's normal ATK for its level

manananggal.carry: the killer gets the dazed upper half floating behind them (not an item); it follows them across maps until they reach the lower half, log out, or the lower half's time runs out
manananggal.announceReunite: {name} reunited the Manananggal! It flew off into the night.

decorationsNote: Repo addition (Halloween 2026 decorations, world/halloween-deco.ts): spiders, bats and the Kapre aren't drawn past decorationNearTiles from the player. townBats: flocks circling over a building (over: its id; lift px above its highest pixel) or a tile (lift px above its ground), on an ellipse (radius x, y px), count bats each. webSpots: the extra cobwebs (props/halloween/webs, manifest halloweenDeco.webs): its tile's top corner + offset px, flip x / y / xy for another corner (they're drawn for a top-left one), sorted at that tile like a prop; two spider houses tucked away.
